summary: Healthcare Realty Trust Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a $400 million senior unsecured delayed draw term loan facility, with an accordion feature for up to $100 million additional capacity, maturing May 15, 2029. No borrowings were outstanding at closing. Interest pricing uses SOFR-based rates with margins ranging 0.675%-1.550% for Term SOFR loans. This is a routine financing agreement for general corporate purposes, not a special-situation event. No terms like stake, premium, or expected close are applicable. Watch for any future draws or amendments that may signal a special situation.
